## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: build_result with zero steps produces verification.passed == false, and...

The system SHALL ensure that build_result with zero steps produces verification.passed == false, and validate_work_result reports it as an error.

#### Scenario: build_result with zero steps produces verification.passed == false, and...

WHEN `reject-vacuous-worker-results-in-the-package-executor` is implemented
THEN build_result with zero steps produces verification.passed == false, and validate_work_result reports it as an error.

### Requirement: A result naming a commit absent from the package worktree fails validation

The system SHALL ensure that a result naming a commit absent from the package worktree fails validation.

#### Scenario: A result naming a commit absent from the package worktree fails validation

WHEN `reject-vacuous-worker-results-in-the-package-executor` is implemented
THEN A result naming a commit absent from the package worktree fails validation.

### Requirement: The integration gate returns a blocking status, and dag_scheduler does not...

The system SHALL ensure that the integration gate returns a blocking status, and dag_scheduler does not mark the package completed, when its only result is failed or BLOCKED.

#### Scenario: The integration gate returns a blocking status, and dag_scheduler does not...

WHEN `reject-vacuous-worker-results-in-the-package-executor` is implemented
THEN The integration gate returns a blocking status, and dag_scheduler does not mark the package completed, when its only result is failed or BLOCKED.

### Requirement: Every existing emitter still validates against work-queue-result: new schema...

The system SHALL ensure that every existing emitter still validates against work-queue-result: new schema fields are optional or all emitters are migrated in the same change.

#### Scenario: Every existing emitter still validates against work-queue-result: new schema...

WHEN `reject-vacuous-worker-results-in-the-package-executor` is implemented
THEN Every existing emitter still validates against work-queue-result: new schema fields are optional or all emitters are migrated in the same change.
